aboutGame.title: What Is RoChess?
paragraphs: RoChess is a competitive online chess game on Roblox built by 1 Elo Chess. It combines rated matches against real players and 19 AI opponents with nine time controls, more than 1,300 rated puzzles, and recognition for over 3,800 openings.

Every match follows standard chess rules and ends with an accuracy review that highlights strong moves, mistakes, and blunders. Use the guides to choose a time control, drill openings and tactics, and turn each game into a clear next step.

faq.title: RoChess FAQ
faq.description: Straight answers about RoChess time controls, codes, bots, puzzles, and game review.

items.question: What is RoChess?
items.answer: RoChess is a competitive online chess game on Roblox built by 1 Elo Chess. It offers rated matches against players and 19 AI opponents, nine time controls, more than 1,300 rated puzzles, and recognition for over 3,800 openings.

items.question: Is RoChess free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Rated games, bot practice, and puzzles are available without spending Robux. Optional gamepasses add conveniences such as expanded game review, VIP access, or additional bots.

items.question: Which RoChess time control should beginners use?
items.answer: Start with Rapid. The slower clock gives you time to check captures, threats, and king safety; move to Blitz after your accuracy becomes consistent, and treat Bullet as a short reflex drill.

items.question: How do RoChess codes work?
items.answer: Open the Shop, switch to the Codes section, and enter each code exactly as written. Current codes are SOYSLOPGAMES for 3 Tokens, CORDCODE for 5 Tokens, and 1000LIKES for 10 Tokens.

items.question: What can I practice against RoChess bots?
items.answer: RoChess includes 19 bots across Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert, and Master tiers. Use the easiest tiers to learn piece safety, then move up only when you win consistently without hanging material.

items.question: How does game review work in RoChess?
items.answer: After a match, RoChess shows an accuracy score and analysis that highlights strong moves, mistakes, and blunders. Use the live evaluation bar during play to notice swings, then review those positions afterward.

items.question: Do RoChess codes expire?
items.answer: Codes can expire quietly as milestones and events end. Redeem new codes soon after they appear and check the Codes page for the current working list.
